**Zendesk Suite** (includes email, chat, messaging, help center, and AI):
- Team: $55 per agent/month
- Growth: $89 per agent/month
- Professional: $115 per agent/month
- Enterprise: $169 per agent/month (starting at; annual billing)
- Enterprise Plus: $219 per agent/month (estimated; custom pricing)

**Zendesk Support** (email + help center only):
- Team: $19 per agent/month
- Professional: $55 per agent/month
- Enterprise: $115 per agent/month

Suite is our most popular option for teams that want to support customers across multiple channels from one place.
